_comment: Pinned site list for the SPIKE-10 scripted collection mode. 40 real sites,
chosen to span the bundling strategies that actually determine a
content-hash cache hit rate: hashed-filename SPA bundles, unhashed vendor
bundles, CDN-served libraries, and server-rendered pages with few scripts.
Pinned because the list IS the reproducibility contract: the cross-day rate
is only comparable day over day if the same sites are visited each session.
Changing this list invalidates comparison with earlier sessions -- if it
must change, record the change in the SPIKE-10 result.
Public homepages only. No authenticated pages, no personal accounts, and
nothing behind a login. The recorder stores URL + digest + size only, but
the browsing itself should still be unremarkable.
